scope: seed42 validation-only, static B J/Q/T, three completed datasets
independent_review: Original completion audit passed; integration review receipt is recorded separately after independent recomputation.

metric_notes.quantity: original quantity scale, lower is better; percentage=(single/J-1)*100
metric_notes.time: legacy clamped loss, not normalized NLL; report absolute delta only
metric_notes.selected_mae: MAE at each raw-RMSE-selected checkpoint, not MAE-selected
metric_notes.same_epoch: all 120 paired boundaries retained; final epoch120 is separate from primary selectors
metric_notes.phase_means: Descriptive post-hoc unweighted means over stated epochs; no statistical replicates. Fixed per-epoch population.
metric_notes.train_validation_names: history row quantity_train_loss is validation log-MSE; nested train.quantity_train_loss is actual training log-MSE.
metric_notes.clipping: Percent of training batches with preclip gradient norm >1. Not parameter-update suppression or evidence of a causal mechanism.
